description: Refinements to lower ground floor conservatory and basement extension through removal of  low external wall, installation of full height sliding doors, and reinstatement of larger external steps. Replace glazed flat roof at ground floor level with glass-box extension incorporating solid floor structure and internal walk on rooflight. Installation of glazed sliding doors out to a Juliet balcony with metal railings balustrade.  Create access from living room by lowering sill of window to form archway; Single-storey extension to closet wing, aligning depth with No.ÿ40 Halsey Street. New timber-framed glazed doors to the rear of extended wing. Widening opening to half-level study within partition to accommodate new double doors. Sunroom will include full-height sliding doors and Juliet balcony with painted or PPC metal balustrades.
